title: Add an enum value with a migration
prompt: Add a third user role, "viewer", after "member" and "admin" (the default stays "member"). This project deploys with migrations: add the migration file migrations/0002_add_viewer_role.sql with exactly the SQL `inferlo db migrate add_viewer_role --allow-change` would generate, so the database accepts the new role, and update migrations/snapshot.json the same way, so that running `inferlo db migrate` afterwards finds no changes. You cannot run commands.
